title: Three settings loaded without a configuration framework
task: Write `settings.Load(env map[string]string) (Settings, error)` with `Port` (int, default 8080), `DatabaseURL` (required), and `Timeout` (a duration parsed with `time.ParseDuration`, default 30s). An error says which key is missing or malformed and what was found. Keep it as small as it can be; we do not need a configuration framework, tags, or reflection.
